# watchpoint_monitor_group (Resource)

A monitor group organizes monitors into a collection with shared group-level profile inheritance (location / threshold / alert / SLA). Monitor-level profiles override group-level ones.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_monitor_group" "example" {
  name        = "Production APIs"
  description = "All production-facing API monitors"
  color       = "#3B82F6"
  icon        = "globe"
  tags        = ["team:payments", "env:prod"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable group name.

### Optional

- `alert_profile_id` (String) Alert profile inherited by monitors in this group.
- `color` (String) Hex color used for the group's UI accent, in `#RRGGBB` form (e.g. `#3b82f6`). Any valid 6-digit hex is accepted; the portal's color picker offers these presets: `#0f766e`, `#3b82f6`, `#10b981`, `#f59e0b`, `#ef4444`, `#14b8a6`, `#ec4899`, `#f97316`, `#64748b`.
- `description` (String) Free-form group description.
- `expected_response_type_severity` (String) Severity raised on a response-type mismatch. Defaults to `Warning`.
- `expected_response_types` (String) Comma-separated allowed Content-Types inherited by HTTP monitors in this group.
- `icon` (String) Icon shown for the group in the UI. Must be one of the supported names: `folder`, `server`, `globe`, `database`, `shield`, `activity`, `cloud`, `box`, `layers`, `cpu`, `network`, `zap`, `gauge`. Any other value is stored but renders as the default `folder` icon.
- `location_profile_id` (String) Location profile inherited by monitors in this group.
- `sla_profile_id` (String) SLA profile inherited by monitors in this group.
- `sort_order` (Number) Display sort order. Defaults to `0`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags inherited by every monitor in the group. Use `key:value` to group cost-allocation spend, or a plain label. A tag set on a monitor overrides the group's value for the same key. Unordered.
- `threshold_profile_id` (String) Threshold profile inherited by monitors in this group.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Monitor group ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_monitor_group.example grp_001
```
